cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(python)

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../common.cmake)

# Builds python.so: MicroPython (main/upy/, generated by tools/gen_upy.sh)
# and the app around it. project_so() compiles every .c under main/, so the
# interpreter's sources need no list; the .c files that MicroPython
# #includes from others are .inc in main/upy/ for that reason.
#
# NDEBUG: MicroPython's asserts are for its own development; with them on,
# the embed port defines __assert_func too.
idf_build_set_property(COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "NDEBUG" APPEND)

# -O2 instead of the -Os every .so gets: an interpreter's loop is all the
# app does, and it is measured (README.md, "Measured"). project_so() puts
# the toolchain's flags after its own -Os, so this one wins.
string(APPEND CMAKE_C_FLAGS " -O2")

include(elf_loader)
project_so(python)
